subject: world_language
concept: Holding a short conversation that recounts a past event and includes an opinion about it
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'sustained narrative interaction' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences conversation cards combining a past event and a reaction/opinion
exercise.abstract: Student performs a short spoken or written conversation recounting a past event and giving an opinion about it

assessment.mastery_threshold: conversation includes a correctly formed past-tense account plus a genuine opinion statement
misconception_flags: mixes past and present tense inconsistently within the same account

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
